item.title: Food Standards Agency should do more in the fight against ultra-processed foods | Letters
item.summary: Mike Pender responds to an article by Felicity Lawrence in which she reflects on why food firms are panicking and suing Felicity Lawrence’s alarming piece on ultra-processed foods ( Why are ultra-processed food firms panicking and suing? Because they know time is running out, 7 August ) made no mention of the UK’s Food Standards Agency, whose primary statutory objective is to protect public health from risks arising from the consumption of food. The FSA is an independent, non-ministerial government department. Its advice to ministers, and guidance to consumers, is informed by the most up-to-date scientific evidence, free of political or commercial considerations. Continue reading...
